description: This PHP file defines the CacheService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing static methods to retrieve cache adapter instances, utilizing the Symfony Cache component and project-specific configurations.

classes.name: CacheService
classes.description: Provides static methods for obtaining cache adapter instances, primarily managing filesystem-based cache with optional namespace segmentation.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns a cache adapter instance for the specified namespace, creating a new FilesystemAdapter if one does not already exist for that namespace.
